correctness.rationale: The bracket-preserving triangular automorphism parametrization and composition are derived directly. Coprime norm splitting on a finite abelian p-group gives scalar-fixed projections; Frobenius computes every p-power torsion count. Scalar conjugation and Burnside give the exact joint class-order divisor sum and centralizer size. The exponent boundary is computed with the fixed subgroup of a primitive scalar. All model checks on the standalone script passed, but no finite check substitutes for the proof.
